title: Entity extraction where one near-miss says the word without being a match
rationale: The one criterion no other case carries: a documented EXAMPLE of the flag, on an ordinary row. A worker that pattern-matches on the word reports four keys and names x_088, which is a forbidden term here. This is what "distinguish an actual match from something that resembles one" means operationally.
task: Which handler keys are deprecated? Return the keys exactly as written and nothing else.
